decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1. The proposal would result in unacceptable living conditions for the occupiers of the proposed residential units due to cramped internal living space and a lack of private amenity space contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), London Plan Policy 3.5 (Quality and Design of Housing Developments) and SPG 10 (Private Amenity Space).

2. The proposed rear roof extension and two storey rear extension would result in unacceptable amenity impacts on adjoining and nearby properties by way of loss of daylight, outlook, and privacy contrary to Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extension and alterations).

3. The proposal would result in insufficient on-site car parking, that would give rise to unacceptable on-street parking on a busy road, harmful to the free flow and safety of traffic and pedestrians on the adjoining highway contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) and H.3.4 (Conversion of Houses to Flats).

4. The proposed removal of the front first floor window, the rear roof extension and three storey rear extension would result in an unacceptable size and scale of development that is not in keeping with the scale of the existing building and would negatively affect the appearance of the area contrary to Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extension and alterations). 

5. The proposal does not make adequate provision for the storage of waste and recycling for the restaurant or the residential flats contrary to Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and ENV-P.2.4 (Recycling Facilities in New Developments).
description: Erection of a part three-storey, part single storey rear extension to provide an enlarged commercial kitchen to the existing takeaway, conversion of the upper floors to provide two one-bedroom flats and one two-bedroom flat together with the installation of a kitchen extract flue on the rear elevation
